title: Transforming the Landscape of Drug Innovation in AI Era: AlphaFold 3 and Beyond.
authors: He, Songlin; Zhou, Liangbin; Wang, Xiaoshuai; Li, Chenzhong; Jiang, Cheng; Tuan, Rocky S; Li, Zhong Alan
one_liner_zh: 该文综述了AlphaFold 3在药物研发全流程中的应用前景与挑战，虽聚焦蛋白质结构预测工具，但以应用综述为主，缺乏方法创新，与蛋白质结构计算课题相关但贡献有限。
abstract: The traditional drug discovery and development (DDD) pipeline has long been characterized by inefficiency and high costs. The rapid evolution of artificial intelligence (AI), especially AI-based toolkits for protein structure and interaction prediction, exemplified by AlphaFold 3 (AF3), promises to reshape the landscape of drug innovation. AF3 advances structural biology by predicting protein structures and their interactions with a range of biomolecules, including nucleic acids, small-molecule ligands, and ions, potentially changing the conventional DDD paradigm, although prediction accuracy varies substantially across these categories. This perspective examines the impact of AF3 on drug target identification and validation, hit identification, lead optimization, and personalized clinical decision-making, while addressing the technical challenges, ethical considerations, and governance implications. Solutions to overcome current limitations are proposed to advance the development of novel therapeutics.
abstract_zh: 传统的药物发现与开发（DDD）流程长期以来以效率低下和高成本为特征。人工智能（AI）的快速发展，尤其是以AlphaFold 3（AF3）为代表的基于AI的蛋白质结构及相互作用预测工具包，有望重塑药物创新的格局。AF3通过预测蛋白质结构及其与多种生物分子（包括核酸、小分子配体和离子）的相互作用，推进了结构生物学的发展，可能改变传统的DDD范式，尽管其预测准确性在这些类别之间存在显著差异。本视角审视了AF3在药物靶点识别与验证、先导化合物发现、先导化合物优化以及个性化临床决策中的影响，同时探讨了技术挑战、伦理考量和治理影响。为克服当前局限性，提出了解决方案，以促进新型治疗药物的开发。
